imps-college-of-engineering-and-technolo.description: IMPS College of Engineering and Technology is a private engineering college at Nityanandapur near Kazigram in Malda district, West Bengal.
imps-college-of-engineering-and-technolo.about: The college was founded in 2003 by the IMPS Educational Trust. It is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal. It offers B.Tech programmes in civil, computer science, electronics and communication, and electrical engineering.
imps-college-of-engineering-and-technolo.address: Nityanandapur, Kazigram, Chandipur, Malda, West Bengal 732103
imps-college-of-engineering-and-technolo.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

dumkal-institute-of-engineering-and-tech.description: Dumkal Institute of Engineering and Technology is a self-financed engineering college at Basantapur in the Dumkal area of Murshidabad district.
dumkal-institute-of-engineering-and-tech.about: DIET was established in 2001 and is run by the Basantapur Education Society. Its campus covers about 26 acres near Dumkal. It is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (formerly WBUT) and offers B.Tech programmes in electrical, electronics and communication, and mechanical engineering among others.
dumkal-institute-of-engineering-and-tech.address: PO Basantapur, PS Dumkal, Dist Murshidabad, West Bengal 742406
dumkal-institute-of-engineering-and-tech.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

govt-college-of-engineering-and-textile-.description: Government College of Engineering and Textile Technology, Berhampore is a Government of West Bengal engineering college in Berhampore, Murshidabad, that grew out of a silk weaving institute.
govt-college-of-engineering-and-textile-.about: The college began on 19 July 1927 as the Government Silk Weaving and Dyeing Institute, set up in the Berhampore central jail premises to train local silk artisans. It took its present name in 2002. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to MAKAUT, and offers textile technology, computer science, mechanical and electrical engineering.
govt-college-of-engineering-and-textile-.address: 4 Cantonment Road, PO Berhampore, Dist Murshidabad, West Bengal 742101
govt-college-of-engineering-and-textile-.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

murshidabad-college-of-engineering-and-t.description: Murshidabad College of Engineering and Technology is an engineering college at Banjetia near Berhampore, supported by the Murshidabad Zilla Parishad.
murshidabad-college-of-engineering-and-t.about: MCET was established in 1998 with support from the Murshidabad Zilla Parishad. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. It offers four-year B.Tech programmes in computer science, electrical, civil, and electronics and communication engineering, plus BBA and BCA courses.
murshidabad-college-of-engineering-and-t.address: Banjetia, PO Cossimbazar Raj, Berhampore, West Bengal 742102
murshidabad-college-of-engineering-and-t.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

global-institute-of-management-and-techn.description: Global Institute of Management and Technology is a private engineering college at Palpara More on the national highway near Krishnagar, Nadia.
global-institute-of-management-and-techn.about: GIMT was established in 2009. It is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology (formerly WBUT) and approved by AICTE. It is located at Bhatjangla near Krishnagar, the district headquarters of Nadia.
global-institute-of-management-and-techn.address: Palpara More, NH-12 (formerly NH-34), Bhatjangla, Krishnagar, West Bengal 741102
global-institute-of-management-and-techn.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

hemnalini-memorial-college-of-engineerin.description: Hemnalini Memorial College of Engineering is a private engineering college at Balindi, Haringhata near Kalyani in Nadia district.
hemnalini-memorial-college-of-engineerin.about: The college was set up by the Bhattacharya Engineering Education and Research Trust with an emphasis on environmental science and engineering. It is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal. Its campus is near the Jaguli-Kalyani crossing at Haringhata.
hemnalini-memorial-college-of-engineerin.address: Gate No. 7, Balindi, Haringhata, Near BSF Camp, Jaguli Kalyani More, West Bengal 741246
hemnalini-memorial-college-of-engineerin.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

ideal-institute-of-engineering.description: Ideal Institute of Engineering is a private engineering college opposite Kalyani Shilpanchal railway station in Kalyani, Nadia.
ideal-institute-of-engineering.about: The institute was founded in 2010 and began classes in 2011 after receiving AICTE approval and MAKAUT affiliation. It is located at Kalyani Shilpanchal. It offers B.Tech programmes in computer science, electrical, mechanical, civil, and electronics and communication engineering.
ideal-institute-of-engineering.address: Kalyani Shilpanchal, Opposite Kalyani Shilpanchal Railway Station, PO Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal 741235
ideal-institute-of-engineering.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

indian-institute-of-information-technolo.description: IIIT Kalyani is an Institute of National Importance set up by the Government of India, the Government of West Bengal and industry partners in public-private partnership mode.
indian-institute-of-information-technolo.about: The institute was created on a not-for-profit PPP basis, funded 50:35:15 by the Ministry of Education, the Government of West Bengal and industry partners WEBEL, Coal India and Rolta Foundation. It received Institute of National Importance status in March 2017. It currently runs from a temporary campus at the Webel IT Park in Kalyani while its 34 acre permanent campus is built. B.Tech seats are filled through JEE Main and JoSAA counselling.
indian-institute-of-information-technolo.address: WEBEL IT Park, Opposite Kalyani Water Treatment Plant, Near Buddha Park, PO Kalyani, Dist Nadia, West Bengal 741235

jis-college-of-engineering.description: JIS College of Engineering is the flagship autonomous engineering college of the JIS Group in Kalyani, Nadia, accredited by NAAC with an A grade.
jis-college-of-engineering.about: JISCE was established in 2000 as the first institute of the JIS Group. In 2011 it became the first private engineering college in West Bengal to receive autonomous status from UGC. It is accredited by NAAC with an A grade.
jis-college-of-engineering.address: Block A, Phase III, Kalyani, Nadia, West Bengal 741235
jis-college-of-engineering.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal
